en: Job 36

p.src: 1  Elihu also continued, and said,

en: Elihu also continued, and said,
u.src: 1  Elihu also continued, and said,

p.src: 2  “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.

en: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.
u.src: 2  “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.

p.src: 3  I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

en: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
u.src: 3  I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

p.src: 4  For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.

en: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
u.src: 4  For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.

p.src: 5  “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.

en: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.
u.src: 5  “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.

p.src: 6  He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.

en: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.
u.src: 6  He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.

p.src: 7  He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.

en: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.
u.src: 7  He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.

p.src: 8  If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,

en: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,
u.src: 8  If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,

p.src: 9  then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

en: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.
u.src: 9  then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

p.src: 10  He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.

en: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.
u.src: 10  He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.

p.src: 11  If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

en: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
u.src: 11  If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

p.src: 12  But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.

en: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.
u.src: 12  But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.

p.src: 13  “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.

en: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.
u.src: 13  “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.

p.src: 14  They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.

en: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.
u.src: 14  They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.

p.src: 15  He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.

en: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.
u.src: 15  He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.

p.src: 16  Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.

en: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.
u.src: 16  Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.

p.src: 17  “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.

en: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.
u.src: 17  “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.

p.src: 18  Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.

en: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.
u.src: 18  Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.

p.src: 19  Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?

en: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?
u.src: 19  Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?

p.src: 20  Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.

en: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.
u.src: 20  Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.

p.src: 21  Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.

en: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.
u.src: 21  Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.

p.src: 22  Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?

en: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?
u.src: 22  Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?

p.src: 23  Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?

en: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?
u.src: 23  Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?

p.src: 24  “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.

en: “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.
u.src: 24  “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.

p.src: 25  All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.

en: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.
u.src: 25  All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.

p.src: 26  Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.

en: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.
u.src: 26  Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.

p.src: 27  For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,

en: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,
u.src: 27  For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,

p.src: 28  which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.

en: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.
u.src: 28  which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.

p.src: 29  Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of his pavilion?

en: Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of his pavilion?
u.src: 29  Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of his pavilion?

p.src: 30  Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.

en: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.
u.src: 30  Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.

p.src: 31  For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.

en: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.
u.src: 31  For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.

p.src: 32  He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.

en: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.
u.src: 32  He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.

p.src: 33  Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also, concerning the storm that comes up.

en: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also, concerning the storm that comes up.
u.src: 33  Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also, concerning the storm that comes up.
